description.value: A two-level Walmart Supercenter in New Westminster offering a full grocery section alongside general merchandise including electronics, clothing, and furniture. As one of the larger retail destinations in the area, it provides a one-stop resupply option for touring cyclists needing food, household goods, or basic supplies. The supercenter format means a broad grocery selection is available under one roof.
